objective: Resume a project using compact handoff and linked records rather than replaying an entire conversation.
scenario: A new session receives a current project state and session handoff with approved decisions, evidence IDs, blockers, and next action.
expected_behaviors: Identify the project and current stage.
Preserve approved decisions and their references.
Identify unknowns, blockers, and exact next action.
Read only the linked source records needed to continue.
prohibited_behaviors: Claim full continuity if the handoff is incomplete.
Require the entire old conversation when current records suffice.
